triage.source: PLACEHOLDER rules copied from contracts/examples/manifest.malaria_thin.json; Track E replaces them with sourced thresholds. 1000 cells matches NLM Malaria Screener's capture target (CameraActivity.totalCellNeeded), which is not a clinical threshold.

provenance.source: NLM Malaria Screener thin-smear CNN (https://github.com/LHNCBC/MalariaScreener), converted from TensorFlow to ONNX with tf2onnx 1.17.0. Exact upstream file and hash: UNVERIFIED (see README).
provenance.licence: UNVERIFIED: the root LICENSE is BSD-style with NLM attribution, but 85+ source files carry GPLv3 headers and the weights have no licence or provenance file (docs/spikes/S1-malaria-screener.md). Weights stay out of git until resolved.
training_data: UNVERIFIED: not documented by NLM; probably the NIH malaria cell_images set (27,558 cell crops)
provenance.notes: quality and uncertainty values are PLACEHOLDERS from the contract example; calibrate them on this pack's field images. Output column 0 is P(parasitized), so labels are [parasitized, uninfected].
